title: Beneficiation: concentrating minerals from bulk regolith
bottleneck: Useful minerals — ilmenite for oxygen, anorthite for aluminum — are mixed through bulk regolith at low concentrations; processing raw dirt wastes enormous energy heating worthless rock. On Earth, beneficiation uses water, gravity separation, and flotation — none of which work well on the airless Moon, where water is scarce, 1/6 g weakens gravity separation, and vacuum breaks flotation. Electrostatic and magnetic separation work in principle but are unproven at the throughputs ISRU needs.
why_it_blocks: Without concentration, every extraction process must handle 5-10x more mass, multiplying power demand, equipment wear, and plant size beyond what a base can support.
current_state: Lab studies of electrostatic and magnetic lunar beneficiation exist; no pilot-scale system and no lunar demonstration.

sources.title: Lunar Soil Yields Oxygen and Water: Breakthrough in Space Resource Utilization
